items.description: File category the generator must read.

referencedTags.description: Tags from other configurations whose classes may be referenced in code generated by this module's generators.

additionalProperties.description: Name of the configuration from which to retrieve the tag.

variables.description: Global configuration variables that can be used in all configuration properties.

tagVariables.description: Per-tag configuration variables that can be used in configuration properties that support them.

rootModule.description:
Root module definition used for grouping generated artifacts, such as translation files.

- Default: `{module:head}`.
- Templating: `{module}`.

translateReferences.description:
Whether reference list labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

translateProperties.description:
Whether property labels must be translated in this configuration.

- Default: the value set in the global `i18n` section.

langs.description: Target languages for which missing translations must be generated.

rootPath.description:
Path to outgoing (missing) translation directories.

- Default: `{lang}`.
- Templating: `{lang}`.
- Per-tag variables: **yes**.
